# Reaper-MCP

> DAW automation via Reaper with OSC control. Austrian precision for professional audio production.

## Key Links

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — full reference
- [README](README.md) — quick start
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md) — installation guide

## Quick Facts

- Ports: 10797 (backend + MCP HTTP `/mcp`), 10796 (Vite dashboard)
- 6 portmanteau tools: transport, tracks, project, system, reascript, orchestrator
- OSC UDP on localhost:8000 → Reaper DAW
